# Closure proof capture fixture

These files are the small public-account subset and staged response from
`basanos/out/runs/dcg-closure-v2-generic-dispute-r4-20260923/plans/`. The
response is `entry-119.dgr1`; the account manifest is retained beside the
document, positions, page, and roots bytes. The proof test derives the compact
duplicate-last sibling path from the captured page leaves and checks both the
honest finalized-leaf proof and address substitutions for all four account
roles.

The larger routes and payload accounts are intentionally omitted. This is a
proof-helper fixture, not a full generic-dispute or kernel-replay capture.
